intro: Give viewers a small, automatic Twitch ad countdown. The add-on only displays timing supplied by Streamer.bot; it never starts or snoozes ads.

sections.title: 1. Turn it on
sections.description: Enable the Twitch-only display and choose when its small warning appears.
sections.notice: YouTube does not expose ad timing triggers through Streamer.bot, so YouTube is intentionally not offered here.

sections.title: 2. Viewer wording
sections.description: Use short headings and reassuring messages that fit the compact card.

sections.title: 3. Overlay appearance
sections.description: Adjust the compact card without changing its safe size or countdown spacing.

sections.title: 4. Connect Streamer.bot
sections.description: Import the included package, then attach exactly two Twitch ad triggers.
sections.notice: Upcoming Ad Intake: Twitch > Ads > Upcoming Ad. Ad Run Intake: Twitch > Ads > Ad Run. Leave Preview Upcoming, Preview Active, and Clear Display triggerless so you can run them manually while offline.

sections.title: 5. Add the browser source
sections.description: Copy the overlay URL shown below into OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop. Use a compact 480 x 180 source and crop or position it rather than stretching it.
